title: No Surprises
lyrics:
[00:06.00]A heart that's full up like a landfill
[00:14.91]A job that slowly kills you
[00:21.52]Bruises that won't heal
[00:30.72]You look so tired, unhappy
[00:36.53]Bring down the government
[00:42.80]They don't, they don't speak for us
[00:55.48]I'll take a quiet life
[01:00.77]A handshake of carbon monoxide
[01:07.55]No alarms and no surprises
[01:13.51]No alarms and no surprises
[01:20.14]This is my final fit
[01:24.84]My final bellyache
[01:31.16]With no alarms and no surprises
[01:38.09]No alarms and no surprises
[01:44.39]No alarms and no surprises, please
